tools.name: viewer_get_state
tools.description: Return the current mechanical CAD view and part visibility.

tools.name: viewer_reset
tools.description: Restore the fitted isometric mechanical CAD view and show all parts.

tools.name: sv3d_set_view
tools.description: Switch the mechanical CAD camera to isometric, front, side, or top.

tools.name: sv3d_orbit
tools.description: Orbit the mechanical CAD camera by azimuth and elevation degrees.

tools.name: viewer_zoom
tools.description: Set the mechanical CAD view zoom as an absolute multiple of the fitted view.

tools.name: sv3d_fit_view
tools.description: Fit the camera to all visible mechanical CAD parts.

tools.name: sv3d_set_part_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide one tessellated mechanical CAD part by index, or restore all parts.

tools.name: sv3d_set_model_opacity
tools.description: Set the opacity of all mechanical CAD parts to reveal occluded internals.

tools.name: sv3d_set_render_mode
tools.description: Switch the mechanical CAD model between shaded and wireframe rendering.

tools.name: sv3d_set_cutaway
tools.description: Set the cutaway plane along a chosen axis to expose the internal geometry of the mechanical CAD parts.

tools.name: sv3d_set_reference_view
tools.description: Show one indexed mechanical reference image beside the 3D model.

tools.name: sv3d_set_reference_zoom
tools.description: Set the active mechanical reference image zoom as an absolute scale.

tools.name: sv3d_set_reference_pan
tools.description: Pan the active mechanical reference image by normalized x and y offsets.

tools.name: sv3d_reset_reference_view
tools.description: Reset the active mechanical reference image zoom and pan.

tools.name: sv3d_select_part
tools.description: Select or deselect one tessellated mechanical CAD part by stable part index; selecting marks its bounds. Omitting selected means select.

tools.name: sv3d_pick_entity
tools.description: Raycast the mechanical mesh at normalized 3D viewport coordinates and append the hit point selection.

tools.name: sv3d_clear_selection
tools.description: Clear all mechanical part and mesh-point selections.

tools.name: viewer_pick_point
tools.description: Return the world point under a normalized viewport position, or wait for the expert to click visible geometry when no position is given.

tools.name: sv3d_measure
tools.description: Measure the straight-line distance between two clicked points on the mechanical CAD surface, with per-axis deltas.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_distance
tools.description: Measure the straight-line distance between two selected mesh reference points in model units.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_distance_exact
tools.description: Compute the exact B-Rep minimum distance between two selected parts (solids) via the pinned OpenCascade kernel.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_angle
tools.description: Measure the angle formed by three selected mesh reference points in degrees.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_bounds
tools.description: Measure one tessellated part axis-aligned bounding box in model units.

tools.name: sv3d_fit_plane
tools.description: Fit a least-squares plane through three or more selected mesh reference points and report the departure of each point in model units.

tools.name: sv3d_clear_measurements
tools.description: Clear all mechanical mesh measurement overlays and results.

tools.name: sv3d_render
tools.description: Render the current mechanical CAD view and return its state.
